with wk as (select unnest([DATE '2025-12-29']) as week_start), cut as (select p.week_start, p.territory_id, p.basis, p.projected_trx from reporting.v_rx_projection p join wk using (week_start) where p.product_id = 'BXA'), clean as (select wk.week_start as target, c.week_start from wk join raw.calendar c on c.week_start < wk.week_start where c.holiday_flag = 0 and c.plan_year_reset = 0 and not exists (select 1 from reporting.v_feed_health h where h.week_start = c.week_start and h.health_status <> 'PASS') qualify row_number() over (partition by wk.week_start order by c.week_start desc) <= 4), share as (select cl.target, r.territory_id, sum(r.trx) / sum(sum(r.trx)) over (partition by cl.target) as s from clean cl join reporting.v_reportable_rx r on r.week_start = cl.week_start and r.product_id = 'BXA' group by 1, 2), nat as (select c.week_start, sum(c.projected_trx) filter (where c.basis <> 'estimated') / (1 - coalesce(sum(s.s) filter (where c.basis = 'estimated'), 0)) as national from cut c left join share s on s.target = c.week_start and s.territory_id = c.territory_id group by 1 having count(*) filter (where c.basis <> 'estimated') > 0) select avg(national) from nat
